title: NIHFW National Hospital Directory ? Ernakulam coordinate quality review (not a spatial layer)
publisher: National Institute of Health and Family Welfare (NIHFW), Government of India; hosted by data.gov.in
license: Government Open Data License - India (GODL-India), stated by the resource page; attribution required
crs: Not stated in resource schema or CSV
coordinate_order: Not stated; raw comma-delimited Location_Coordinates values are preserved without assigning latitude/longitude order
units: Coordinate field contains comma-delimited numeric strings when present; datum and units are not stated
geographic_coverage: Rows whose source attributes are State=Kerala and District=Ernakulam; district attribution is not independently verified
limitations: Resource page documents Location_Coordinates but does not state coordinate order or CRS.
The Ernakulam subset has missing/nonnumeric coordinate strings and repeated coordinate pairs; per-row facility location accuracy and current operational status are not established.
A numeric pair within angular ranges is only a syntax/range check, not proof that the coordinate belongs to that facility or district.
No GeoJSON geometry was created and no map/exposure use is permitted until the provider confirms coordinate order, CRS, and positional quality.

validation.coordinate_order: Not documented by source; comma-delimited pair preserved without interpretation.
validation.crs: Not documented by source; no point geometries created.

alternative_sources_reviewed.title: Kerala Health Department institution directory
alternative_sources_reviewed.publisher: Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of Kerala
alternative_sources_reviewed.publication_or_update_date: Not stated on the reviewed directory page
alternative_sources_reviewed.available_evidence: Official institution-search page lists Ernakulam public facility names, facility types, addresses, bed/service fields and View Map controls.
alternative_sources_reviewed.blocker: The accessible page has no downloadable GIS data or exposed latitude/longitude fields; no CRS/datum, geocoding accuracy, stable spatial export schema, or spatial reuse terms were found. Not used to geocode NIHFW records or create map points.
